reasoning: The paper excerpt explicitly requires FP16 activations and multiply-accumulate entirely in the floating-point domain. The RTL instead instantiates an FP8 PE MAC stream with FP8 activation parameters and a pe_bfp_acc block-floating-point accumulator using an integer mantissa. The README also states the test chip moves to FP8 activations. This directly supports the claimed implementation deviation.

RTL module is explicitly an FP8 PE MAC stream.
Accumulator module is block-floating-point, not per-item float.
